'''Gorien Springs''' is a village south of [[Arafel]], on the road from [[Shol Arbela]] to [[Tar Valon]].

It is the birthplace of [[Yukiri Haruna]], an [[Aes Sedai]] and [[Sitter]] of the [[Gray Ajah]]. When she was born, in {{ne|837}}, the village had an inn.
